result.summary: Found 2 visual layout issues: a truncated restaurant name in Popular right now and bottom card content clipped by the tab bar.

issues.description: Restaurant name under 'Popular right now' reads as 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final character clipped off. The title on the same line as the rating '4.8 (500+)' does not have enough space and is cut off without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title row layout to allow full name display - use proper truncation with ellipsis, wrapping, or adjust flex spacing between title and rating so text is not hard-clipped

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card with '-20%' badge is cut off and obscured directly by the bottom tab bar with no padding or spacing, hiding part of the image.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset above the tab bar so scrollable cards are fully visible and not hidden underneath navigation
